name: 金庸群侠传（2008 超豪华版）
english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2008 Deluxe Edition)
english_description: This archive corresponds to the "2008 Deluxe" content release, sharing an identical server engine core with this project's "2008 Enhanced" and "2008 Standard" editions, but with its own adjustments to sect NPCs, combat numbers, and some map scenes — and the largest file size of the three.
